renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium work-motivation action-beat guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair and no extra worker, client, recipient, guardian, human, body clue, reflection, silhouette, empty seat or personal belonging implying someone else. Preserve canonical identity, relative size/colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes with exactly one large plus one small highlight in each visible eye, and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or canonical pair plus the focal work mechanism covers 55–65% and reads at actual width 80px. Freeze the first irreversible-looking motion before completion: lever at first notch, fruit midair, pencil at first mark, snack beginning to slide, first practice step, tile beginning to lift, weight lowering, lock half-dropping, gate first swinging, peg first moving, test droplet first emerging or fruit first reaching the net. Controls stay removable, half-set, unlatched or stoppable. No guaranteed success, productivity, promotion, applause, delivery, harvest, invention or predetermined result. Symbols and isolated geometric reliefs only; no readable text, pseudo-text, handwriting lines, names, labels, score, number, clock, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Keep every composition distinct in camera axis, motion direction, completion boundary and open negative-space shape. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart tip is allowed; no added heart, closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign or deterministic path. Follow compositionFamily, artDirection, distinctFrom and visualReviewFocus literally. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
